n6def444bacd.s: The Santhanam Committee recommended the setting up of:
n6def444bacd.x: The Santhanam Committee recommended the CVC and the CBI; the Lokpal-Lokayukta system came from the First ARC.

n987dd961d0c.s: On which date did the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013 come into force?
n987dd961d0c.x: The Act came into force on 16 January 2014; 1 January 2014 is the date of the President's assent.

n9c008a15563.s: Who chairs the Selection Committee of the Lokpal?
o: The Chairman of the Rajya Sabha
The Speaker of the Lok Sabha
n9c008a15563.x: The Prime Minister chairs the Lokpal Selection Committee; the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha is not a member at all.

nf6322f129b5.s: In which year did Maharashtra establish the first Lokayukta in India?
nf6322f129b5.x: Maharashtra set up the first Lokayukta in 1971, after the first Lokpal Bill (1968) and before the first Lokpal (2019).

nindian-polity-1-50.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: First Administrative Reforms Commission – set up in 1966
First Administrative Reforms Commission – recommended the CVC and the CBI
nindian-polity-1-50.x: The First ARC was set up in 1966 and recommended Lokpal and Lokayuktas. The Ombudsman began in Sweden in 1809, and the term Lokpal was coined by Dr. L.M. Singhvi.

nindian-polity-22-48.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the Lokpal Selection Committee is correctly matched?
o: Chairman of the Rajya Sabha – Member
Speaker of the Lok Sabha – Chairperson
Eminent jurist – nominated by the Chief Justice of India
Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha – Member
nindian-polity-22-48.x: The Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha is a member. The PM is the chair, the Rajya Sabha Chairman is not a member, and the eminent jurist is nominated by the President.

n8f1d524a2e8.s: After the 2016 amendment, the form and manner of asset declaration under the Lokpal law is prescribed by the:
n8f1d524a2e8.x: The 2016 amendment kept the declaration but left its form and manner to be prescribed by the Central Government.

n3fa00014a2d.s: An inquiry by the Lokpal against the Prime Minister requires the approval of the full Bench by:
n3fa00014a2d.x: An inquiry against the PM needs full-Bench approval by at least two-thirds, and it is held in camera.

n5971831df37.s: While appointing a Lokayukta, the Governor generally consults the Leader of the Opposition and the:
o: Chief Justice of the High Court
n5971831df37.x: The Governor consults the Chief Justice of the High Court and the Leader of the Opposition, not the Chief Election Commissioner.

nd872a55c2f9.s: In Andhra Pradesh, complaints against functionaries other than the higher functionaries are dealt with by the:
nd872a55c2f9.x: In AP the Lokayukta deals with higher functionaries and the Upa-Lokayukta with the remaining functionaries.

n2fd1637255a.s: Under the Lokpal law, property acquired by corrupt means can be attached and confiscated:
o: Even while the prosecution is pending
Only after the prosecution is over
Only after the Supreme Court confirms conviction
n2fd1637255a.x: The Lokpal can attach and confiscate tainted property even while the prosecution is pending.

n086de4cabd0.s: The Lokpal exercises superintendence and direction over the CBI in:
o: All Prevention of Corruption Act cases
All cases investigated by the CBI
Only the cases referred by the Lokpal
Only cases against State Government employees
n086de4cabd0.x: The Lokpal supervises the CBI only in cases it refers; the CVC supervises it in Prevention of Corruption Act cases generally.

n40ad317e394.s: State Lokayuktas in India are established under:
o: A single central law under which the Union appoints them
An order of the Chief Justice of India
A direct provision of the Constitution
n40ad317e394.x: Each State sets up its Lokayukta under its own Act, so jurisdiction and coverage differ among States.

nea347402f25.s: The Karnataka Lokayukta, which has its own Lokayukta Police wing, was established under the Karnataka Lokayukta Act of:
nea347402f25.x: The Karnataka Lokayukta was established under the Karnataka Lokayukta Act, 1984, with its own police wing.

n303c57e4ab7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the RTI (Amendment) Act, 2019 and the Rules of 2019?
o: The 2019 Rules fixed the term of an Information Commissioner at five years
The Centre was empowered to fix the tenure of CIC and SIC members
The Centre was empowered to fix the salaries of CIC and SIC members
The 2019 Rules fixed the term of an Information Commissioner at three years
n303c57e4ab7.x: The 2019 Rules fixed the term at three years, not five, using the power the 2019 Amendment gave the Centre to fix tenure and salaries.

n913dbfe8664.s: The minimum tenure of the Director of the CBI is:
n913dbfe8664.x: The CBI Director has a minimum tenure of two years, extendable up to five years since 2021.

n55f8b045052.s: After the Vineet Narain judgment, who decides whether a case is to be investigated by the CBI?
n55f8b045052.x: The judgment did not give investigation decisions to the CVC; the CBI alone decides whether to investigate.

n3a7886d58db.s: The Director of Prosecution of the CBI is appointed on the CVC's recommendation for a term of:
n3a7886d58db.x: The Director of Prosecution is appointed on the CVC's recommendation for a two-year term.

ne1d19155e6f.s: CBI officers of the rank of Superintendent of Police and above are recommended by a committee led by the:
ne1d19155e6f.x: A CVC-led committee recommends CBI officers of SP rank and above; the CVC does not, however, conduct trials of CBI cases.

ndfd35a6f067.s: The Central Vigilance Commission consists of the Central Vigilance Commissioner and not more than how many Vigilance Commissioners?
ndfd35a6f067.x: The CVC has the Central Vigilance Commissioner and up to two Vigilance Commissioners, holding office for four years or until 65.

n61c447cbb97.s: Which body is the competent authority under the Whistle Blowers Protection Act?
n61c447cbb97.x: The CVC is the competent authority under the Whistle Blowers Protection Act; it is a statutory, not constitutional, body.

nb639015758e.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the RTI Act is correctly matched?
o: Section 8(1)(j) – personal information made mandatorily disclosable
RTI appeals involving personal data – transferred to the CVC
Section 8(1)(j) exemption – limited to information held by private companies
nb639015758e.x: The DPDP Act, 2023 amended Section 8(1)(j) to exempt personal information outright, removing the public-interest override.

n7a7e8d71d5b.s: Under Section 5 of the RTI Act, Public Information Officers are designated by:
n7a7e8d71d5b.x: Each public authority designates its own Public Information Officers under Section 5.

n50b857d5710.s: In the Governing Council of NITI Aayog, Union Territories without legislatures are represented by their:
n50b857d5710.x: The Governing Council includes CMs of UTs with legislatures and Lieutenant Governors of the other UTs.

n91083dc9bcf.s: The Regional Councils of NITI Aayog are chaired by the:
o: Chief Minister of the largest State in the region
Lieutenant Governor of a Union Territory in the region
n91083dc9bcf.x: Regional Councils are chaired by the PM or his nominee; CMs and LGs of the region are members.

ne356997ffb2.s: What weight does Financial Inclusion and Skill Development carry under the Aspirational Districts Programme?
ne356997ffb2.x: Financial Inclusion and Skill Development carries 10 percent; Agriculture and Water Resources carries 20 percent.

ne3b962c2a8d.s: Regarding the seven backward districts of Andhra Pradesh under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014, which pair is correctly matched?
ne3b962c2a8d.x: The seven backward districts are 4 in Rayalaseema and 3 in North Coastal Andhra.

new.s: The First Administrative Reforms Commission (1966) was initially chaired by:
new.x: Morarji Desai first chaired the First ARC; K. Hanumanthaiya chaired it later.

new.s: Which report of the First ARC (1966) first recommended State Lokayuktas?
o: Problems of Redressal of Citizens' Grievances
new.x: The First ARC report 'Problems of Redressal of Citizens' Grievances' (1966) first recommended State Lokayuktas.

new.s: In which year was the term 'Lokpal' coined?
new.x: Dr. L.M. Singhvi coined the term Lokpal in 1963.

new.s: Sweden's law of 1766 is known as the world's first:
new.x: Sweden's 1766 law was a right to information law; its Ombudsman came in 1809.

new.s: After the first Lokpal Bill of 1968, how many times was a Lokpal Bill re-introduced and allowed to lapse up to 2008?
new.x: Bills were re-introduced in 1971, 1977, 1985, 1989, 1996, 1998, 2001, 2005 and 2008 - nine times, and all lapsed.

new.s: The first Lokpal Bill, passed by the Lok Sabha in 1969, lapsed because:
o: The Lok Sabha was dissolved before the Rajya Sabha passed it
The Supreme Court struck it down
new.x: The 1968 Bill passed the Lok Sabha in 1969 but lapsed when that House was dissolved before the Rajya Sabha passed it.

new.s: The Lokpal Bill, 2011 was introduced in the Lok Sabha on 4 August 2011 by:
new.x: V. Narayanasamy, Minister of Parliamentary Affairs, introduced the Lokpal Bill, 2011 in the Lok Sabha.

new.s: The Standing Committee that examined the Lokpal Bill, 2011 was chaired by:
new.x: The Standing Committee on Public Grievances, Law and Justice was chaired by Abhishek Manu Singhvi; L.M. Singhvi coined the term Lokpal.

new.s: Which House passed the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Bill first, on 17 December 2013?
o: A joint sitting of both Houses
Neither; it was issued as an Ordinance
new.x: The Rajya Sabha passed it with amendments on 17 December 2013 and the Lok Sabha on 18 December 2013.

new.s: Under the original Lokpal Act, a public servant had to declare assets and liabilities within how many days of entering office?
new.x: The original Act required the declaration within 30 days of entering office.

new.s: The Joint Drafting Committee on the Lokpal Bill (April 2011) was chaired by:
new.x: Pranab Mukherjee chaired the Joint Drafting Committee; Shanti Bhushan was its co-chair.

new.s: Anna Hazare's fast of April 2011 for the Jan Lokpal Bill was held at:
new.x: The April 2011 fast was at Jantar Mantar; the August 2011 fast was at Ramlila Maidan.

new.s: What share of the members of the Lokpal must be judicial members?
new.x: Half the members of the Lokpal are judicial members, and at least half are from SC, ST, OBC, minorities and women.

new.s: The minimum age for appointment as Chairperson or member of the Lokpal is:
new.x: A Lokpal Chairperson or member must be at least 45 years old.

new.s: The Search Committee for the Lokpal consists of at least how many persons?
new.x: The Selection Committee sets up a Search Committee of at least 7 persons, half from SC, ST, OBC, minorities and women.

new.s: The Chairperson and members of the Lokpal are appointed by the:
new.x: The President appoints them on the recommendation of the Selection Committee.

new.s: Under the Lokpal Act, complaints against Group C and D central officials are sent to the:
new.x: Group C and D complaints go to the CVC, which reports back to the Lokpal.

new.s: Under the Lokpal Act, public servants posted outside India are:
o: Covered only if they belong to Group A
Covered only with the consent of the host country
new.x: The Lokpal covers public servants both in and outside India.

new.s: Union Ministers and MPs are excluded from the Lokpal's jurisdiction in respect of:
o: All acts done while in office
Anything said or any vote given in Parliament
new.x: Ministers and MPs are covered, but not for anything said or any vote given in Parliament.

new.s: Under the Lokpal framework, an investigation is ordinarily to be completed within:
new.x: Investigation: 6 months + 6 months. The preliminary inquiry is 90 + 90 days and the trial 1 year up to 2 years.

new.s: After a reference, the Inquiry Wing of the Lokpal must submit its report within:
new.x: The Inquiry Wing reports within 60 days of the reference.

new.s: How many complaints did the Lokpal register in 2024-25?
new.x: The Lokpal registered 292 complaints and disposed of 260 in 2024-25.

new.s: The first Lokpal, Justice Pinaki Chandra Ghose, left office on:
new.x: Justice Ghose left office on 27 May 2022, and the post stayed vacant for about two years.

new.s: The first Lokpal, Justice Pinaki Chandra Ghose, took oath in March 2019 before President:
new.x: Justice Ghose, a retired SC judge, took oath on 23 March 2019 before President Ram Nath Kovind.

new.s: Sushil Chandra, a non-judicial member of the Lokpal, was formerly the:
new.x: Sushil Chandra, a former Chief Election Commissioner, is a non-judicial member of the Lokpal.

new.s: The Central Vigilance Commission was set up in 1964 on the recommendation of the:
new.x: The CVC originated from the Santhanam Committee and was set up in 1964 by executive resolution.

new.s: The Central Vigilance Commission became a statutory body under the CVC Act of:
new.x: The Vineet Narain case (1997) directed statutory status, given by the CVC Act, 2003.

new.s: Which of the following is a member of the committee that selects the Central Vigilance Commissioner?
new.x: The CVC selection committee has the PM, the Home Minister and the Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Central Vigilance Commission?
o: It was set up in 1964 by an executive resolution
It became statutory under the CVC Act, 2003
It supervises the CBI in Prevention of Corruption Act cases generally
new.x: The CVC is a statutory body, not a constitutional one.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Central Vigilance Commission:
1. Its members hold office for 4 years or until the age of 65.
2. It supervises the CBI only in cases referred to it by the Lokpal.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: the CVC supervises the CBI in PCA cases generally; supervision only in referred cases is the Lokpal's role.

new.s: The Whistle Blowers Protection Act, 2014 received the President's assent on:
new.x: The Whistle Blowers Protection Act (Act No. 17 of 2014) got assent on 9 May 2014.

new.s: Under the Whistle Blowers Protection Act, 2014, a whistle blower is a person who makes a:
o: Request for information under the RTI Act
Complaint about service matters to the Lokpal
Public interest disclosure about corruption or wilful misuse of power by a public servant
new.x: A whistle blower makes a public interest disclosure about corruption or wilful misuse of power by a public servant.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Whistle Blowers Protection Act, 2014:
1. Anonymous complaints are not taken up.
2. Complaints are barred after 7 years.
3. An appeal lies to the Supreme Court within 60 days.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: the appeal lies to the High Court within 60 days.

new.s: Which State was the first to pass a Lokayukta law, in 1970?
new.x: Odisha passed the first law (1970) but set up the institution only in 1983; Maharashtra set up the first Lokayukta (1971).

new.s: Which Section of the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, 2013 requires every State to set up a Lokayukta?
new.x: Section 63 requires every State to set up a Lokayukta by its own law within one year.

new.s: Which of the following States has a Lokayukta only, without an Upa-Lokayukta?
new.x: Bihar, UP and HP have a Lokayukta only; Karnataka, Rajasthan, Maharashtra and AP have both.

new.s: In which of the following States is the Chief Minister excluded from the Lokayukta's jurisdiction?
new.x: The CM is excluded in Maharashtra, UP, Rajasthan and Bihar, but included in MP, Gujarat, HP, AP and Odisha.

new.s: By 2013, how many States had Lokayuktas?
new.x: By 2013, 21 States and 1 UT (Delhi) had Lokayuktas.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of State and year of its Lokayukta is correctly matched?
new.x: Bihar's Lokayukta dates to 1973; Karnataka is 1984, UP 1975 and Assam 1986.

new.s: The Bellary illegal iron ore mining report (2011) led to the arrest of:
new.x: Justice N. Santosh Hegde's Bellary report led to the arrest of former minister G. Janardhana Reddy.

new.s: In 2021, the principal seat of the Andhra Pradesh Lokayukta was shifted to:
new.x: After bifurcation the AP Lokayukta worked from Hyderabad and shifted to Kurnool in 2021.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Andhra Pradesh Lokayukta:
1. After bifurcation, it worked from Hyderabad.
2. The AP Lokayukta and Upa-Lokayukta Act, 1983 was amended in 2024.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: it worked from Hyderabad until its move to Kurnool in 2021, and the 1983 Act was amended in 2024.

new.s: Justice (Retd) T. Mallikarjuna Rao was appointed AP Lokayukta in August 2026 for a term of:
new.x: He was appointed under Section 3(1) for a 5-year term under Section 5.

new.s: The CBI was set up on 1 April 1963 by a resolution of the:
new.x: The CBI was set up by an MHA resolution; it is now an attached office under the Ministry of Personnel.

new.s:
Arrange the following in chronological order:
A. Central Bureau of Investigation
B. Delhi Special Police Establishment Act
C. Special Police Establishment
D. Central Vigilance Commission
new.x: SPE (1941), DSPE Act (1946), CBI (1963) and CVC (1964).

new.s: The Central Information Commission consists of the Chief Information Commissioner and up to how many Information Commissioners?
new.x: The CIC has the Chief Information Commissioner and up to 10 Information Commissioners.

new.s: The Central Information Commission was constituted in 2005 under which Section of the RTI Act?
new.x: The CIC was constituted on 12 October 2005 under Section 12 of the RTI Act.

new.s: When first set up in 1964, the Central Vigilance Commission was:
o: A statutory body under the CVC Act
A body under the DSPE Act
new.x: The CVC was set up by executive resolution in 1964 and became statutory only in 2003.

new.s: State Information Commissioners are appointed by the:
o: Chief Justice of the High Court
new.x: The CIC is appointed by the President and the SIC by the Governor.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a member of the committee that recommends the State Chief Information Commissioner?
o: Chief Justice of the High Court
Leader of the Opposition in the Assembly
Cabinet Minister nominated by the Chief Minister
new.x: The SIC panel is the CM, the LoP in the Assembly and a CM-nominated minister; the Chief Justice is not a member.

new.s: A State Information Commissioner may be removed by the Governor for proved misbehaviour after an inquiry by the:
new.x: Under Section 17, removal follows a Supreme Court inquiry on the Governor's reference.

new.s: Who was the State Chief Information Commissioner of Andhra Pradesh in 2025?
new.x: R. Mahaboob Basha was AP's State Chief Information Commissioner in 2025.

new.s: The maximum penalty that can be imposed on a PIO under Section 20 of the RTI Act is:
new.x: The penalty is ₹250 per day up to a maximum of ₹25,000, after a hearing.

new.s: Under Section 19 of the RTI Act, a second appeal to the CIC or SIC lies within:
new.x: The first appeal lies within the public authority; the second appeal goes to the CIC/SIC within 90 days.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of RTI Act Section and content is correctly matched?
new.x: Section 18 deals with complaints; Section 12 constitutes the CIC, Section 5 designates PIOs and Section 20 is the penalty.

new.s: Which body alone can declare an organisation a 'public authority' under the RTI Act?
new.x: The CIC is the only body that can declare an organisation a public authority.

new.s: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 amended which provision of the RTI Act?
new.x: The DPDP Act, 2023 amended Section 8(1)(j) on personal information.

new.s: Before the 2019 amendment, the pay of a State Chief Information Commissioner was equal to that of a(n):
new.x: Earlier, the State Chief IC's pay equalled an Election Commissioner's pay.

new.s: The CBI is an attached office under which Ministry?
new.x: The CBI is under the Ministry of Personnel (DoPT); ED and DRI are under Finance.

new.s: Which body recommended a new law to replace the DSPE Act for the CBI?
new.x: The Second ARC (2007) recommended a new law to replace the DSPE Act.

new.s: The Vineet Narain judgment (1997) quashed the:
new.x: Vineet Narain quashed the Single Directive that required prior sanction to probe senior officers.

new.s: The CBI's OCSAE Prevention/Investigation Unit, set up in 2019, deals with:
new.x: The OCSAE unit (2019) acts against online child sexual abuse material.

new.s: For Interpol, the CBI serves as India's:
new.x: The CBI is India's National Central Bureau for Interpol.

new.s: When did Andhra Pradesh withdraw general consent to the CBI?
new.x: AP withdrew general consent in November 2018 and restored it in June 2019.

new.s: The CBI needs State consent because 'police' falls under which entry of the State List?
new.x: Police is Entry 2 of the State List, so Section 6 of the DSPE Act requires State consent.

new.s: According to the CVC annual report of September 2026, how many corruption cases were pending investigation?
new.x: The report showed 755 corruption cases pending investigation, including 13 Lokpal references.

new.s: The Corruption Perceptions Index is published by:
new.x: Transparency International publishes the CPI, scoring perceived public-sector corruption from 0 to 100.

new.s: What was India's rank in the Corruption Perceptions Index 2025?
new.x: India ranked 91st of 182 with a score of 39 in CPI 2025, up from 96th in 2024.

new.s: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence mainly deals with:
new.x: The DRI handles anti-smuggling and customs evasion under the Finance Ministry's Department of Revenue.

new.s: The Enforcement Directorate was founded in 1956 as the 'Enforcement Unit' under the:
new.x: The ED began in 1956 as an Enforcement Unit under the Department of Economic Affairs; it is now under the Department of Revenue.

new.s: The State Vigilance Commission of Andhra Pradesh was set up in:
new.x: The AP State Vigilance Commission dates from 1964.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about anti-corruption bodies in Andhra Pradesh:
1. The Anti-Corruption Bureau is a State police agency for Prevention of Corruption Act offences.
2. The State Vigilance Commission took over part of the State Public Service Commission's disciplinary role.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: the ACB handles PC Act offences, and the 1964 Vigilance Commission took over part of the SPSC's disciplinary role.

new.s: The Planning Commission was set up on 15 March 1950 by:
new.x: The Planning Commission was set up by a Cabinet resolution and was neither constitutional nor statutory.

new.s: On which date did the Union Cabinet repeal the 1950 resolution that created the Planning Commission?
new.x: The Cabinet repealed the resolution on 13 August 2014, and NITI Aayog replaced the Commission.

new.s: Who was the first chairman of the Planning Commission?
new.x: Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru was its first chairman.

new.s: The National Development Council was set up on 6 August 1952 by:
new.x: The NDC was set up by executive order; it linked the Planning Commission and the States.

new.s: The National Development Council was restructured into which body of NITI Aayog?
new.x: The NDC (PM, all State CMs, Planning Commission members) was restructured into NITI's Governing Council.

new.s: NITI Aayog, set up on 1 January 2015, is best described as:
o: A statutory body set up by an Act of Parliament
A think-tank set up by a Union Cabinet resolution
A body under the Finance Commission
new.x: NITI Aayog was set up by a Cabinet resolution and is neither constitutional nor statutory.

new.s: Who replaced Suman K. Bery as Vice-Chairperson of NITI Aayog in 2026?
new.x: Ashok Kumar Lahiri replaced Suman K. Bery by an order of 25 April 2026.

new.s: The full-time members of NITI Aayog hold the rank of:
o: Secretary to the Government of India
new.x: Full-time members have Minister of State rank; the Vice-Chairperson has Cabinet rank.

new.s: Which NITI Aayog hub builds its think-tank capacity?
new.x: The Knowledge and Innovation Hub builds think-tank capacity; the Team India Hub handles States-Centre engagement.

new.s: Unlike the Planning Commission, NITI Aayog:
o: Was set up by an Act of Parliament
Does not allocate funds to States
new.x: NITI Aayog has no fund-allocation role, which lies with the Finance Ministry and the Finance Commission.

new.s: NITI Aayog's approach to planning is described as:
o: Bottom-up, based on fund allocation to States
new.x: NITI follows a bottom-up approach of cooperative federalism (Team India), unlike the Planning Commission's top-down one.

new.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Planning Commission followed a top-down approach to planning.
2. Both the Planning Commission and NITI Aayog were set up by Cabinet resolutions.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: the Planning Commission was top-down, and both bodies rest on Cabinet resolutions (1950 and 2015).

new.s: The GROW report of NITI Aayog relates to:
o: Groundwater Recharge and Optimal Water use
Greening and Restoration of Wasteland with Agroforestry
new.x: GROW stands for Greening and Restoration of Wasteland with Agroforestry.

new.s: How many indicators does the National Multidimensional Poverty Index use?
new.x: The National MPI uses 12 indicators, including maternal health and bank account, over the Global MPI base.

new.s: According to the National MPI, Andhra Pradesh's multidimensional poverty in 2019-21 was:
new.x: AP fell from 11.77% to 6.06%; India fell from 24.85% to 14.96%.

new.s: The Export Preparedness Index is prepared by NITI Aayog with the:
new.x: The EPI, first released in 2020, is prepared with the Institute for Competitiveness.

new.s: The Atal Innovation Mission was launched in:
new.x: The Atal Innovation Mission (2016) runs Atal Tinkering Labs and incubators.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of NITI Aayog initiative and launch year is correctly matched?
new.x: The WEP began in 2018; ADP is January 2018, ABP January 2023 and AIM 2016.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT an Aspirational District of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Kurnool and Anantapur are not AP aspirational districts; the others are in the original or current list.
